comment: The reaver behind the captain's quarters door (BNpcBase 412, 3282344): 1811 HP. From Bob's Chronofoil captures of Sastasha: five Duty Finder runs (2026-10-22) and one with Duty Support (2026-10-23, 700cc294, whose fights ran longest: the Duty Support members took the hits other players would have). `players` is the median damage to players over all six runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
